en: A sepia-toned, vintage image depicting a large, ornate, 19th-century building with neoclassical architectural elements. The structure features three floors, rounded and rectangular windows, grand stairs, and decorative stonework. There are a few shrubs and a small iron fence in front, as well as a lone lamp post and a person standing on the steps. Tree branches frame the top of the image.
